source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action approve in context external; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means role guest or auditor, except for action approve; a trusted inspect prefers review at priority 80. Action change in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role auditor or context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk TRUE, or action approve in context external; critical cases require allow.

Action change in context external prefers allow at priority 70.

Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == approve) and (event.context == external))

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == guest) or (event.role == auditor)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule TrustedForbidDeny:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = deny

rule ActionChangeExternal:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule RoleAuditorPartner:
    when (event.role == auditor) or (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule Default:
    when (event.role == guest) or (event.role != guest)
    then prefer label = review priority 1
repairs.proposed_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == approve) and (event.context == external))

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == guest) or (event.role == auditor)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule TrustedForbidDeny:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action != approve)
    then forbid label = deny

rule ActionChangeExternal:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule RoleAuditorPartner:
    when (event.role == auditor) or (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule Default:
    when (event.role == guest) or (event.role != guest)
    then prefer label = review priority 1
